title: 不同字符的最小子序列
summary: 返回字符串的字典序最小子序列，使每种不同字符恰好出现一次。
insight: 单调栈维护结果；当前字符未使用时，只要栈顶更大且它后面还会出现，就可弹出让当前较小字符提前，同时不丢失该字符。
pitfalls: 已在栈中的字符直接跳过
只有剩余频次大于零的栈顶才能弹出
输出包含原串每种字符恰好一次

solutions.title: 剩余频次单调栈
solutions.idea: 在保证字符仍可补回时贪心改善字典序。
steps: 扫描 ch 先 remaining--；若 used 跳过
while 栈顶>ch 且 remaining[栈顶]>0，弹出并清 used；压入 ch、标 used，返回栈字符串

code.java: class Solution { public String smallestSubsequence(String s){int[] remaining=new int[26];boolean[] used=new boolean[26];for(char ch:s.toCharArray())remaining[ch-'a']++;StringBuilder stack=new StringBuilder();for(char ch:s.toCharArray()){int index=ch-'a';remaining[index]--;if(used[index])continue;while(stack.length()>0&&stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)>ch&&remaining[stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)-'a']>0){used[stack.charAt(stack.length()-1)-'a']=false;stack.deleteCharAt(stack.length()-1);}stack.append(ch);used[index]=true;}return stack.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun smallestSubsequence(s:String):String{val remaining=IntArray(26);val used=BooleanArray(26);for(ch in s)remaining[ch-'a']++;val stack=StringBuilder();for(ch in s){val index=ch-'a';remaining[index]--;if(used[index])continue;while(stack.isNotEmpty()&&stack.last()>ch&&remaining[stack.last()-'a']>0){used[stack.last()-'a']=false;stack.deleteCharAt(stack.lastIndex)};stack.append(ch);used[index]=true};return stack.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string smallestSubsequence(string s){int remaining[26]={};bool used[26]={};for(char ch:s)++remaining[ch-'a'];string stack;for(char ch:s){int index=ch-'a';--remaining[index];if(used[index])continue;while(!stack.empty()&&stack.back()>ch&&remaining[stack.back()-'a']>0){used[stack.back()-'a']=false;stack.pop_back();}stack+=ch;used[index]=true;}return stack;} };
